}
export type CursorPayload = Record<string, string | number>;
export type InvalidCursor = InputFailure<typeof PaginationErrorCodes.INVALID_CURSOR>;
export const PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT: 20
export const PAGE_SIZE_MAX: 100
export interface Page<TItem> {
    items: TItem[];
    nextCursor: string | null;
}
export interface PaginateOptions<TRow, TItem> {
    cursorOf: (row: TRow) => CursorPayload;
    toItem: (row: TRow) => TItem;
}
export interface PaginationDefaults {
    readonly defaultLimit: number;

}
export const PaginationErrorCodes: { readonly INVALID_CURSOR: "INVALID_CURSOR"; }

  defaults: PaginationDefaults
  encodeCursor: (payload: CursorPayload) => string

  paginate: <TRow, TItem>(rows: TRow[], limit: number, options: PaginateOptions<TRow, TItem>) => Page<TItem>
